title: local-workflow ship witnesses the storage remote, in core and in Commercial Apps
goal: CEO direction 2026-11-11 ("cover the commercial ship path too"). Susi Commercial Apps lands gated work with `cargo local-workflow ship`, a cargo alias for this repository's xtask binary, so the path is covered here: after `ship` and `ship --retry`, whatever the result, local-workflow runs the storage guard against origin in the shipping clone and prints a finding on stderr without changing the ship's result. SUSI_NO_STORAGE_GUARD=1 skips it. The guard source is still the one file in the harness.
limitations: Susi Commercial Apps' own harness fallback (src/harness.rs calling its copy of git_governor when the core harness CLI is unavailable) and its `susi-commercial` release and task-queue pushes do not start the guard.
